0.00-2.92  VIC (e3_s1 0.58-3.50, punch 1.14). Frame 0 a face mid-word, caption and tag already up. "I BUY TICKETS TO MATCHES" / "I CAN'T GO TO." Tag VIC / IN. HUNDRED PERCENT. for the whole shot.
2.92-8.04  Loop board, HOW TO BUY A TICKET, day tag 61 DAYS BEFORE* from here. Narrator "To buy a ticket, | a supporter needs | a history of buying tickets." Top box alone at first; marker leaves on "supporter"; second box REQUIRED: A TICKET BOUGHT BEFORE at 5.22 ("a history of"); loop closes at 6.37 ("tickets."); caption leaves and red NOT ELIGIBLE lands at 6.79 with thud and jolt; held 1.25 s, nothing said.
8.04-10.08  VIC (4.46-6.50, real time, cut before the microphone moves). "KEEPS MY RECORD UP." (voice ends 9.18), tag again. Caption leaves at 9.20; ATTENDED 11 lands 9.42, BOUGHT 19 lands 9.66, each with a tick, in his silent stare.
10.08-11.04  VIC, jump cut a little tighter (6.71-7.67, real time, punch 1.30): the microphone is gone, his eyes drop towards the numbers. Tag and counters hold across the cut. Finished pair 11 / 19 on screen 9.66-11.04 (1.38 s).
11.04-15.54  Chat: header and chip seen 0.33 s, push-in to 1.43. Vic "Got six. All on my phone." 11.17; Maya "One short. Put a name in for the last ticket. Any name." 12.29; Lee "My landlord." 14.50, held 1.0 s. Danny is typing… throughout.
15.54-21.83  Name cards, BALLOT FOR ONE TICKET. Grid held 0.88 s under "The group put in nine names."; eight cards turn to UNSUCCESSFUL 0.21 s apart in scrambled order (16.42-18.13); "One came out." as DANNY'S GRANDMOTHER turns, landing green SUCCESSFUL at 19.39 as the caption leaves; "The winner had not been asked." 19.79-21.5.
21.83-24.17  Chat, full screen, silent: "Maya added Danny's grandmother" (9 members) 22.08; "Danny's grandmother left" (8 members) 23.21.
24.17-27.29  GRANDMOTHER (gran_go 0.17-3.29, punch 1.06). Seen 0.25 s before the caption. "I'M NOT IN THE GROUP CHAT." / "I JUST GO." Mantel clock ticking in her room. No pin.
27.29-30.88  Sign-off on the same shot running on (3.29-6.88, zoom 1.06 to 1.12, no jump). Label DANNY'S GRANDMOTHER / ONE TICKET. HER OWN. at 27.44; her look to the lens about 28.3; VENUVOY and "Next episode: Thursday. Confirmed." at 28.59; small smile at the end; ticks and the two notes as house; hard cut.
checked:
Two half-size drafts (plus one sound-only pass), then one final render. On the drafts: contact sheets and single frames at every event (frame 0, each cut, stamp hit, counters, jump cut, chat pops, card turns, winner, both system lines, her first caption, sign-off steps). On the final: 12 full-size frames from the 9:16 and 5 from the 4:5 (captions, tag, counters, day count, sign-off label and foot all inside the 4:5). Timeline read back: no two captions overlap, each caption leaves before the stamp, counters or winner card arrives, nothing but captions in rows 1250-1480, no corner wordmark. Speech recognition on the final file returns every scripted word in order. Sound on the final mix: -14.1 LUFS; no 5 ms window under -65 dBFS anywhere (no holes at cuts); room tone about -40 dBFS under boards, chats and sign-off; spoken lines 24-39 dB above everything else in the phone band (the one "low" line margins.py prints, 9.66-10.56, is crowd noise in the silent stare against the counter ticks, not a voice); narrator within about 1.5 dB of Vic and the grandmother in the phone band; thud level with a spoken line in that band and the heaviest effect; message pops about -25 dBFS. Hazards: Vic's first piece ends at 6.50 before the microphone moves, second piece checked frame by frame to 7.63 (new microphone enters at 7.67, not used); grandmother not used past 6.88. Draft folder and the final's "ov" folder deleted.

left: Vic's stare has a jump cut that the cut sheet does not ask for. The take gives only 0.9 s of clean stare between his last word (5.60) and the microphone moving (6.50), which cannot hold the finished 11 / 19 for 1.3 s in real time. I cut before the microphone moves and jump a little tighter to the live tail after it has gone (6.71-7.67), as Episode 1 does with Jo. In that tail his eyes are lowered rather than holding the look, so the beat ends on a flicker of doubt, not pure certainty.
Length is 30.9 s against 'about 28 s' plus the longer sign-off (about 29.8 s). The extra second is the stare tail and the loop built on the narrator's words (5.1 s instead of 4.7 s).

Vic's name tag second line is set at 34 px (house default 38) in both his shots, so the tag and the counters fit side by side left of x 960 with a gap. The counters sit at x 572, y 1050, right of the tag, not at x 60.

The first chat screen is filmed with right-hand bubbles ending at x 730 so it can be pushed in to 1.43 with the chip fully out of frame; at 1.14 with default bubbles the chip OWE MAYA: 6 was cut by the frame edge. While pushed in, the top rows 0-30 show a sliver of the header ('8 members'), as in Episode 1.
The second chat screen (added / left) is not pushed in: any push-in either cuts the chip or loses '9 members'. The two system lines are therefore 35 px, readable but the smallest text in the episode.

The sign-off starts at 3.29 of her shot (3.58 s long), not 3.25 (3.6 s), to leave 0.36 s after 'I just go.' before the label; the house sounds are at their house offsets. It is muted like the others, with her room sound faded out over the first 0.25 s.
Name tags and the counters fade over their last 0.14 s before the cut (the engine's tag behaviour; I gave the counters the same fade so the band leaves as one).

Sound departures from house numbers, made after measuring: message pops -8 / -13 dB (house -10 / -15) to reach about -25 dBFS; room tone -8 dB as one continuous bed from the loop to the end; narrator lines raised 2-4 dB and Vic's second line lowered 1.5 dB to bring them level in the phone band.
Speaker captions on Vic's shots are hand-timed cards (needed to have the caption up on frame 0), so the gold word highlight runs up to about 0.15 s off the spoken word in places.
The grandmother's caption sits at y 1300, not 1260, to keep it off the teacup.
